# Code Checks

Auto-generated reference for the **Code Checks** API. 2 endpoint(s).

For curated narrative + UI / CLI walkthroughs see the corresponding section under
[Pipeline workflows](../../workflows/pipeline-overview.md), [Deployment](../../deployment/plan.md),
[Observability](../../observability/run-events.md), or [Extensions](../../extensions/contracts.md).
The checks themselves, their plugins and the sandbox are described in [Code checks](../../extensions/code-checks.md).

### `GET /api/code-checks`

**List Checks**

Every registered code check with its languages, kind (`builtin`, `external`, `detector`), binary, whether the binary is `available` on this host and whether the check is `allowed` (built-ins always; anything else only when its id is in `CODE_CHECK_ALLOWED`). `network_isolation` is `{mode, available}`: `available` is false when the host forbids unprivileged user namespaces, in which case `auto` runs external checks without network isolation and only `require` refuses to run them.

**Responses**

| Status | Schema | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | `object` | `{checks: [{id, languages, kind, binary, available, allowed}], network_isolation: {mode, available}}` |


### `POST /api/code-checks/run`

**Run Checks**

Run checks over a snippet (ADMIN / ENGINEER when auth is on; `code` up to 200 KB). Without `check_ids` the default selection runs: every available, allowed, non-detector check for the language. Result: `{ok, results: [{check_id, ok, messages, skipped}]}`; `ok` is true when every check that ran passed and null when none ran. `skipped` is one of `unavailable`, `not_allowed`, `language_mismatch`, `timeout`, `no_schema`, `no_module_dir`, `unknown_check`.

**Request body** (required)

Content type: `application/json` — `RunCodeChecksRequest`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `language` | `string` | yes | Language id or alias (`py`, `js`, `sh`, `tf`, `golang`, ...). |
| `code` | `string` | yes | The snippet. |
| `check_ids` | `string[] \\| null` | no | Run exactly these checks. |
| `context` | `object \\| null` | no | Only `json_schema` is honoured; server-side keys such as `module_dir` are dropped. |

**Responses**

| Status | Schema | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | `object` | Successful Response |
| `422` | `HTTPValidationError` | Validation Error |
